source: CRON 2026-10-14: BOC Kenya Plc unaudited group results for the six months ended 30 June 2026, announced through the NSE on 21 August 2026. Unit KES. Revenue KES 600.01m, gross profit KES 330.54m, overheads KES 190.80m, profit before tax KES 157.55m, profit after tax KES 100.38m, EPS KES 5.14, interim dividend KES 4.00. Cost of sales is revenue less the printed gross profit, income tax is profit before tax less profit after tax, and net finance costs is the balancing item (net finance income of KES 17.81m, shown negative).
source_note: Farmed from the kenyanstocks.com statement API on 2026-09-21. Every cell is computed: line items carried from the source (0 where absent), group subtotals and statement totals computed by identity.
